title: DAY 2 — LESSON 1: RESPECTING COLLEAGUES, SUPERVISORS AND MANAGEMENT

questions.prompt: What is the best definition of workplace respect?
options: Agreeing with everyone at all times
Treating people with dignity and professional consideration

questions.prompt: A colleague makes a mistake. What is the most respectful response?
options: Correct the issue without humiliating the person
Mock the colleague in front of others
Tell other employees before addressing the issue

questions.prompt: You disagree with a supervisor's instruction. What should you do?
options: Respond angrily and refuse to discuss it
Raise your concerns respectfully and seek clarification

questions.prompt: Who is responsible for demonstrating workplace respect?

options: Respect allows professional disagreement and appropriate boundaries
